TABLE.NAME: report_evidencereporter_samp
TABLE.COMMENT: Validation samples: how each was drawn, so it can be shown and reproduced.

FIELD.NAME: filters
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: courses, units, dates, result, marks, spread, size

FIELD.NAME: seed
FIELD.COMMENT: Draw code: the same filters and population give the same sample

FIELD.NAME: population
FIELD.COMMENT: Eligible judgements when drawn

FIELD.NAME: populationhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-1 of the eligible judgements, to tell whether a reproduction drew from the same population

TABLE.NAME: report_evidencereporter_sitem
TABLE.COMMENT: Judgements in a validation sample, including any swapped out (kept, with the reason).

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner

FIELD.NAME: competencyid
FIELD.COMMENT: The unit

FIELD.NAME: result
FIELD.COMMENT: The rating when drawn, e.g. Competent

FIELD.NAME: proficiency
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 proficient, 0 not, null not rated

FIELD.NAME: mark
FIELD.COMMENT: Average percentage across linked activities when drawn

FIELD.NAME: groupkey
FIELD.COMMENT: The group it was drawn from when spread

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: drawn or replacement

TABLE.NAME: report_evidencereporter_tool
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment tool details for an activity, for its assessor guide: version, review and assessor information Moodle doesn't hold.

FIELD.NAME: toolversion
FIELD.COMMENT: Version of the assessment tool, e.g. 1.2

FIELD.NAME: reviewdate
FIELD.COMMENT: When the tool was last reviewed before use

FIELD.NAME: reviewedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Who reviewed it, as typed (someone without an account here)

FIELD.NAME: reviewedbyid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who reviewed it, chosen from staff

FIELD.NAME: conditions
FIELD.COMMENT: Assessment conditions, e.g. workplace or simulated environment

FIELD.NAME: resources
FIELD.COMMENT: Resources allowed

FIELD.NAME: instructions
FIELD.COMMENT: Instructions for the assessor

FIELD.NAME: adjustments
FIELD.COMMENT: Reasonable adjustment guidance

TABLE.NAME: report_evidencereporter_radj
TABLE.COMMENT: Reasonable adjustments made for a learner in an assessment.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The assessment (activity)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner

FIELD.NAME: adjtype
FIELD.COMMENT: Kind of adjustment, e.g. extratime, reader, scribe

FIELD.NAME: details
FIELD.COMMENT: What was adjusted

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why (may touch on disability or health)

FIELD.NAME: approvedby
FIELD.COMMENT: Who approved it, as typed (someone without an account here)

FIELD.NAME: approvedbyid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who approved it, chosen from staff

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: manual, or the Moodle setting it was confirmed from: quizoverride, assignoverride, assignextension

FIELD.NAME: sourceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The override or extension it was confirmed from

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who recorded it

TABLE.NAME: report_evidencereporter_jsnap
TABLE.COMMENT: What each judgement was made against, as it was at the time: the competency's and framework's wording and the assessor's credentials.

FIELD.NAME: evidenceid
FIELD.COMMENT: The judgement (competency evidence)

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner

FIELD.NAME: compidnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency ID number when judged

FIELD.NAME: compshortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency name when judged

FIELD.NAME: compdescription
FIELD.COMMENT: Competency description when judged

FIELD.NAME: fwidnumber
FIELD.COMMENT: Framework ID number when judged

FIELD.NAME: fwshortname
FIELD.COMMENT: Framework name when judged

FIELD.NAME: assessorid
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the judgement, when known

FIELD.NAME: credentials
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: the assessor's credentials from the chosen profile fields when judged

FIELD.NAME: backfilled
FIELD.COMMENT: 1: recorded on upgrade, after the judgement, with no credentials
